framework: UIKit (Pointer, menus and shortcuts, focus, Pencil)
bifrost: springboard/ui/src/menu.rs, springboard/ui/src/keys.rs, springboard/ui/src/tracking.rs, springboard/ui/src/cursor.rs, springboard/ui/src/focus.rs, springboard/src/shell/editmenu.rs, springboard/ui/src/pointer_lock.rs, springboard/ui/src/band_select.rs, springboard/ui/src/focus_halo.rs, springboard/sdk/src/pointer_focus.rs
summary: Menus, pop-up buttons, key equivalents, Home Screen quick actions in the Dock menu, a context menu request from apps, tracking areas, a cursor stack, a key-view loop and an on-screen edit bubble exist. Context menu interactions with previews, edit menu interactions for SDK views, pointer effects, band selection, focus effects and pencil interactions are missing. Pointer lock, band selection and the focus halo have pure models and an SDK surface (springboard/sdk/src/pointer_focus.rs) built on parity/team-p-pointer-focus, not yet wired into the shell. Context menu interactions with previews, edit menu interactions for SDK views, pointer effects, focus groups and pencil interactions are still missing.
rea_evidence: not captured: tools/parity/rea-page.sh reported 'no CDP browser on 127.0.0.1:9333 (run: tools/parity/rea-page.sh --start)'; facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: items with checkmarks, separators, disabled rows and keyboard stepping; no submenus as nested elements, no deferred elements, no inline or destructive display styles
ViewApp::set_menus and MenuEntry publish the app's menus to the shell menu bar; the tablet UI has no menu bar, so the menus have nowhere to show unless an app menu is drawn in-app
parse, display and conflict-checked registry; no shortcut discoverability overlay for held Cmd
a dark bubble with Cut, Copy, Paste for shell text controls; SDK views use the responder actions but cannot ask for the bubble
Ctx::context_menu sends items for the shell to show at a point; no long-press trigger on touch, no preview, no per-view interaction
tracking areas and cursor shapes exist; no hover or highlight lift effects on controls, and the app protocol has no pointer move without a button
tracking speed and button settings; shape morphing is not offered

scene-scoped lock held only by the key scene; relative motion while held. The shell does not yet route a scene's request or its deltas to the pointer; built on parity/team-p-pointer-focus; not yet verified on the tablet

rubber band model with a movement threshold, extend and replace, for pointer and touch drags; the shell does not yet start a band from empty space in a collection; built on parity/team-p-pointer-focus; not yet verified on the tablet
key-view loop in reading order and nearest-view arrow movement; no focus environment tree, no guides, no focus groups

halo geometry around the focused view, corner radius capped at 6 pt; the SDK focus_ring in springboard/sdk/src/view/controls.rs does not call it yet; built on parity/team-p-pointer-focus; not yet verified on the tablet
stylus samples exist (springboard/ui/src/stylus.rs); the pen's side button and tap gestures are not delivered to apps

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/quick_actions.rs, springboard/sdk/src/quick_actions.rs, springboard/sdk/src/runtime.rs, springboard/proto/src/lib.rs, springboard/src/shell/quick_actions.rs, springboard/src/shell/services/quick_actions.rs, springboard/src/shell/desktop_bar.rs
features.note: built on parity/team-p-quick-actions; not yet verified on the tablet. Static [[quick_action]] manifest items and dynamic items from the SDK are shown in the Dock's menu on the desktop form factor (secondary click) and delivered as Input::QuickAction; the tablet draws no Dock menu and its Home Screen icon long press still starts edit mode

gaps: Long-press context menu with preview for touch
Edit menu invocation from SDK views
Hover events and pointer effects for controls
Pencil tap, squeeze and hover pose
Shell wiring for pointer lock, band selection and the focus halo
